JOYSTAR Angel Girls' Bike - Sizes 20" to 24"
Let her confidence soar with the JOYSTAR Angel Girls' Bike. Designed for growing riders aged 7-12, the Angel combines a graceful low-step frame with high-performance braking, perfect for neighborhood exploration and building independence on two wheels.

Elegant design meets effortless riding: The JOYSTAR Angel 24-inch.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered with a focus on safety, the Angel features a kid-friendly geometry and a dual-braking system to ensure a secure transition to adult-style riding."
Superior Braking & Control
The JOYSTAR Angel is equipped with a sturdy Hi-Ten steel frame designed to survive the bumps of learning. It features a sophisticated dual-braking system: a front caliper hand brake for precision stopping and a rear coaster brake for intuitive control. This combination helps older children safely master hand-braking while retaining the reliability of a pedal brake.

Key Features & Benefits

Growth-Friendly Design: The adjustable comfort saddle and slack seat-tube angle allow the bike to grow with your child, ensuring years of comfortable riding.

Kid-Specific Geometry: A low standover height makes it easy for young riders to mount and dismount safely.

Protective Shielding: A full chainguard keeps clothing clean and fingers safe from the drivetrain.

Stylish Accessories: Includes a classic front basket for personal items and DIY decal stickers for a custom look.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get riding sooner! The JOYSTAR Angel arrives 85% pre-assembled. We provide all necessary tools and a straightforward guide to help you finish the setup in about 20 minutes.

Assembly Guide: Quick setup so she can get pedaling in a flash.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Experience the joy: Smooth riding and effortless control on neighborhood paths.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR provides a premium warranty to ensure your child’s ride is always ready for adventure:

The Frame (Lifetime): Steel frames are guaranteed against manufacturing defects for the life of the original owner.

Global Support: Our dedicated service team is ready to help with assembly, maintenance, or replacement parts.
